conventions: bpp = Mbps*1e6/(W*H*fps) of the recorded file resolution; fixed = codecs whose bitrate does not scale with resolution/fps choice

cameras.name: Kinefinity MAVO Edge 8K
cameras.notes: Current spec page + KineOS 7.x/8.0. Internal ProRes RAW was announced at launch (Apr 2020) but never shipped: Kinefinity said in early 2021 it would not implement ProRes RAW (CineD, Mar 2021); current spec page lists only ProRes. KineRAW (KRW) is not offered on MAVO Edge. Uncompressed DNG added in KineOS 8.0 at 4K only. Media: 2x KineMAG Nano (NVMe M.2). Resolution keys prefixed 'crop-' are the spec page's 'Other Cropping' modes. KineOS 8.0 BT.2020 ProRes mode is limited to 4K (same fps as RAW). Internal H.264 is for live streaming only, not recording.

codecs.name: ProRes 4444 XQ
codecs.ref: Apple ProRes White Paper target data rate ProRes 4444 XQ 1920x1080 29.97p = 500 Mb/s (bpp = Mbps*1e6/(1920*1080*29.97)). Kinefinity publishes no per-mode ProRes bitrates (spec page lists codec only); ProRes is variable bitrate, Apple target used. MAVO Edge 8K spec page (Record Codec table): ProRes 4444XQ/4444 12-bit, ProRes 422HQ 10-bit 'ProRes 422/LT included'; no Proxy listed. Spec page lists codec 'ProRes' for every mode with no per-flavour fps limits, so all modes/fps assumed for each flavour (real 4444XQ ceilings at 8K high fps not published).

codecs.name: Uncompressed RAW (DNG, 12-bit)
codecs.ref: ESTIMATE. KineOS 8.0 (Nov 2024) adds lossless uncompressed RAW as DNG, 4K only (sensor data processed to 4K): Edge 8K FF 4K OG 4096x2644 2~45fps, FF 4K DCI 4096x2160 2~55, FF 4K UHD 3840x2160 2~55, S35 4K DCI/UHD 2~72 (KineOS 8.0 Upgrade Notes). Kinefinity publishes no data rate; bpp = 12 bits per photosite for uncompressed 12-bit Bayer DNG (file headers/metadata ignored).

cameras.name: Kinefinity MAVO Edge 6K
cameras.notes: Current spec page (KineOS 7.3/8.0 era) + Operation Manual KineOS 7.0. Full-frame 6K 3:2 24MP sensor. No ProRes RAW and no KineRAW on this camera; spec page lists 'Uncompressed RAW DNG 12-bit' (KineOS 8.0, 4K only). S35 4K 4:3 (4096x3072, 80fps) and S35 4K 6:5 (4096x3432, 70fps) are from the KineOS 7.0 manual table and KineOS 7.3 notes, not on the current spec page. 'crop-' keys = 'Other Cropping' modes. Media: 2x KineMAG Nano NVMe (slot A full speed, slot B high speed per manual).

codecs.name: ProRes 4444 XQ
codecs.ref: Apple ProRes White Paper target data rate ProRes 4444 XQ 1920x1080 29.97p = 500 Mb/s (bpp = Mbps*1e6/(1920*1080*29.97)). Kinefinity publishes no per-mode ProRes bitrates (spec page lists codec only); ProRes is variable bitrate, Apple target used. MAVO Edge 6K spec page (Record Codec table): ProRes 4444XQ/4444 12-bit, 422HQ 10-bit 'ProRes 422/LT included'; no Proxy. cameras.name: Kinefinity MAVO LF
cameras.notes: Original 2018 full-frame 6K camera, now listed as Discontinued on kinefinity.com (no current spec page). Data from MAVO LF Operation Manual KineOS 6.4 (2020, linked from kinefinity.com 'Operation Manual (KineOS 6.4)' page; retrieved via its Dropbox link). Media: 2.5" SATA SSD (KineMAG). KineRAW 2.0 (KRW) was announced at launch but never released (Kinefinity dropped KRW2.0, Mar 2021). No ProRes RAW. cDNG was removed by a later firmware update (2021). Frame rates per manual p.52 (launch spec sheet had lower values, e.g. OG 40fps, raised in KineOS 6.3).

codecs.name: ProRes 4444 XQ

codecs.name: Compressed RAW cDNG 3:1
codecs.ref: ESTIMATE. Manual (KineOS 6.4) p.50: Compressed cDNG 12-bit, ratios 3:1/5:1 (KineOS 6.x; 7:1 appears in the MAVO 6K manual, not the LF manual). bpp = 12 bits / 3 = 4.0. Only modes marked 'ProRes or RAW' in manual p.52 table (oversampled modes are ProRes only). Kinefinity removed CinemaDNG from MAVO LF via a later firmware update (announced 1 Mar 2021); available only on KineOS 6.x firmware before that.

codecs.name: Compressed RAW cDNG 5:1
codecs.ref: ESTIMATE. Manual (KineOS 6.4) p.50: Compressed cDNG 12-bit, ratios 3:1/5:1 (KineOS 6.x; 7:1 appears in the MAVO 6K manual, not the LF manual). bpp = 12 bits / 5 = 2.4. Only modes marked 'ProRes or RAW' in manual p.52 table (oversampled modes are ProRes only). Manual p.26 Duration Reference @KineMAG 1TB 25fps: 6K cDNG(5:1) 2h, 5K 2h, 4K 3h50 -> 6K ~1.11 Gb/s = 2.33 bpp at 6016x3172 25p, consistent with 2.4. Kinefinity removed CinemaDNG from MAVO LF via a later firmware update (announced 1 Mar 2021); available only on KineOS 6.x firmware before that.
